lines: Years passed. Ismail grew into a boy who could walk and work beside his father.
Then Ibrahim saw a dream. And the dreams of prophets are revelation.
He said: "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I sacrifice you. So see what you think."
And the boy answered: "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the patient."
When they had both submitted, and Ibrahim laid him down on his forehead...
Allah called to him: O Ibrahim, you have fulfilled the vision. Indeed, this was the clear trial.
"And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice."
Every Eid al-Adha, Muslims around the world remember this moment: a father and a son who loved Allah more than anything.
